opening.comment: The agent's first turn does not greet the caller or give the agent's own name or the company name, so the opening criterion is not met.

verification.quote: Agent: Name and order number or postcode.
verification.comment: The agent asked for name and order number, and the caller gave a name and order number, so verification was requested before order details were discussed, though the caller's name was only given as a first name and the order number was misheard in the transcript.

understanding.quote: Customer: My parcel never arrived. It's been 72 working days and um absolutely furious, this is it the second time.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue of a non-arrived parcel but then asked nothing further and did not acknowledge the repeat occurrence, and the summary of the order was garbled.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Right. I've opened lost parcel investigation. It closes within 9 working days and then we a replacement within 3 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says the investigation closes within 5 working days, not 9, so the stated timeline is incorrect; also the policy only opens an investigation after 10 working days, which the caller's 12 days of transit may satisfy but was not stated.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: I'm putting you on hold.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank the caller when returning, which the policy requires.

communication.quote: Customer: My parcel never arrived. It's been 72 working days and um absolutely furious, this is it the second time.
communication.comment: The caller said they were absolutely furious, but the agent did not acknowledge the frustration or apologise at any point.

closing.quote: Agent: get an email when the investigations closes. Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step and asked if anything else was needed, then closed politely, which meets the closing criterion.
